landing.heroTitle: Where Talent Meets Opportunity Without Barriers
landing.heroSubtitle: A trusted platform connecting skilled professionals with verified employers — built on fairness, transparency, and real career growth.
landing.heroGoal: Equalio is built to remove barriers in hiring — helping job seekers discover genuine opportunities and enabling employers to hire trusted talent with confidence.
landing.searchPlaceholder: Search by Job Title, Skill or Location
landing.searchHint: Explore verified opportunities across different industries and skill levels. Filter by experience, salary and job type to find what fits you best.
landing.featuredSubtitle: Handpicked and verified openings from trusted employers. Updated regularly to ensure genuine and active listings.
landing.step1Desc: Sign up and build your professional profile. Add your education, experience and skills. The more complete your profile, the better your chances.
landing.step2Desc: Browse verified job listings and apply directly. No middlemen, no hidden process. Track your applications from your dashboard.
landing.step3Desc: Employers review your profile and contact shortlisted candidates. Attend interviews, receive updates and move forward in your career with clarity.
landing.successSubtitle: When opportunity meets preparation, growth follows. Here are stories from candidates and employers who connected through this platform.
landing.readyTitle: Ready to Take the Next Step?
landing.readySubtitle: Whether you are searching for a job or hiring talent, start today. Build your profile, explore opportunities and become part of a professional and responsible community network.
landing.trustFooter: A system built on trust, skill and community responsibility.
